package.description: A lightweight, tray-resident Windows "File History"-style continuous versioned backup tool.

en-US.description: A lightweight, tray-resident Windows "File History"-style continuous versioned backup tool.
en-US.longDescription: FileHistoryClone revives the spirit of Windows File History: it watches the folders you choose and keeps a timestamped copy every time a file changes, stored as plain files you can open in Explorer. Continuous (not scheduled), 100% local, no cloud, no subscription.
en-US.name: FileHistoryClone
